result.topic_en: Scratch calculations on the addition theorem for the lemniscatic (and more general elliptic) sine, of the form $(x\sqrt{(1-y^4)}+y\sqrt{(1-x^4)})/(1+xxyy)$ and a variant with modulus $\mu$, together with spherical trigonometry formulas and a Fourier-type expansion of $1/\sqrt{1-\cos p^2\cos q^2}$.
